evidence: Prior to the first ALD deposition, the unloaded reactor was baked at 400 °C and exposed to 300 cycles (1 cycle = 0.1 s (TMA/N2) + 4 s N2 + 0.1 s (H2O /N2) + 4 s N2) in order to encourage reproducible reaction behavior and reduce any spurious wall deposition/reaction effects due to residual precursor components from previous depositions. High purity (99.999%) N2 is used as the purging gas and film depositions were performed at sample/reactor temperatures of 300 °C.
